torch_memory_saver==0.0.8 resolved the previous import failure; SGLang loaded its 8B weights but its static memory pool at gpu_memory_utilization=0.15 could not allocate the KV cache. Smoke config raised the pool to 0.25 for the next retry.

SGLang memory saver worked and the model loaded, but the KV-cache profiler returned zero at gpu_memory_utilization=0.25. SGLang computes this budget using post-load available memory and a per-worker available-memory baseline captured before loading weights; the earlier estimate using total physical VRAM was incorrect and is withdrawn. The retry config was raised to 0.75.

The 0.75 static fraction successfully allocated a 287,404-token KV cache; SGLang then rejected its auto-selected FlashAttention v3 backend on B200 SM100. The retry config now explicitly selects SGLang FlashInfer.

FlashInfer initialized and allocated a 250,054-token KV cache. CUDA graph capture failed because Ray workers could not find ninja on PATH. ninja==1.13.2 exists in .venv/bin; the launcher now prepends that directory to PATH.

ninja was found and the FlashInfer CUDA sources compiled, but the final host link failed with an undefined reference to BatchDecodeWithPagedKVCacheKernel. The log also confirmed cuda_graph_max_bs in engine_kwargs was ignored by this ATPO wrapper. The runner now selects SGLang Triton attention and sets max_num_seqs=8 through the supported max_running_requests path.
Retry using SGLang Triton attention and max_num_seqs=8. Config validation passed; Ray worker and dataset initialization are complete, and model-role initialization is in progress.
